title.narrative: Accelerating the deployment of e-motos in Rwanda

description.narrative: Transport sector accounted for 13% of the total greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions in Rwanda in 2015. More than a quarter of these emissions were estimated to come from motorcycles - the dominant transport mode in the country and its capital, Kigali, including the motorcycle taxis, or “motos”. Tapping into Rwandan government’s ambition to electrify and decarbonise public transport, the project aims at catalysing the deployment of e-motorcycles and foremost effectively substituting motos with e-motos. As a direct effect of the intervention, the project aims to support deployment of up to 46,000 e-motos in Kigali within the project’s implementation period and in 10 years after that. It is expected that it will result in 422,556 tCO2e as direct GHG emissions mitigation and 96,398 tCO2e as indirect mitigationduring the project implementation period.
